storage: Airtight dry container, away from light and heat, at room temperature; best used within about 6 months after opening.
looksLike: a fine, bright to brick-red hot powder, usually with a sharp smell that makes you cough or sneeze.
howToPick: an even red colour and a clean, sharp smell; avoid a very bright unnatural red, clumps, or a musty smell.
shelfLife: about 6 to 12 months sealed (general guidance; not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 0.3 g per serving (a pinch, ⅛ tsp)
